summary: Each iteration repeats the local CSR kernel. Rank-local row offsets and columns are distributed; emitted timed host code inlines indexed work, arithmetic, stores, and row/nonzero/iteration backedges.

source_evidence.claim: Distribution constructs rowOffsets for local rows and transfers row offsets/columns; spmvCpu traverses every row's CSR range and stores its sum. Parsed iterations control the repeated timed calls; gathered output covers the row partition.

compiled_evidence.claim: The actual timed runBenchmark path records MPI_Wtime and inlines the CSR work inside an outer iteration counter: indexed row-boundary/column/value/vector loads, multiply/add and row stores appear in the loop body, with nested nonzero/row branches and an iteration increment/compare/backedge before ending MPI_Wtime.
